validation: The request email must be a string with an acceptable email-address format before authentication. Assess email syntax separately from SQL injection protection.
protection: Request email data must not alter executable SQL structure at the authentication query. Determine whether the email is passed as a bound data parameter or sufficiently protected for this exact SQL use. Password hashing is not evidence about the email operand.

validation: Email and password must each be nonempty strings after normalization before account creation. The requirement applies even when passwordRepeat is absent. TypeScript annotations do not validate JSON at runtime.
protection: An account must not be created with an empty or whitespace-only email/password. Inspect required-field gates, normalization order, next()/return paths, model validators, setters and hooks. A challenge observer or a password hash does not establish this constraint.
